name: free-crypto-news-extension
description: Free Crypto News: breaking crypto headlines, category feeds, and a live BTC/ETH/SOL price ticker in your browser.

scripts.build: pnpm run generate-icons && vite build && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../free-crypto-news-extension.zip .
